<sf-input-choice id="c2" label="Куда сохранять копии" name="targets" multiple value="local" items='[{"value": "local", "label": "Этот сервер", "caption": "Быстро, но пропадёт вместе с сервером"}, {"value": "s3", "label": "Хранилище S3", "caption": "Отдельно от сервера"}, {"value": "ftp", "label": "FTP", "caption": "Устаревший способ", "disabled": true}]'></sf-input-choice>

checks.title: single is a radiogroup of native radios named by the label and described by the hint; multiple a group of checkboxes; each input named by its title and described by its description

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#c1 [role=radiogroup]'); const label = document.getElementById(g.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const hint = document.getElementById(g.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#c1 input')]; const first = r[0]; return label.textContent.trim().startsWith('Тип сайта') && hint.textContent.trim() === 'Тип можно сменить позже.' && r.length === 3 && r.every((i) => i.type === 'radio' && i.name === r[0].name && !i.form) && document.getElementById(first.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Сайт' && document.getElementById(first.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.trim() === 'Страницы, разделы и меню' && document.querySelector('#c2 [role=group]') !== null && [...document.querySelectorAll('#c2 input')].every((i) => i.type === 'checkbox') && document.querySelector('#c3 [role=radiogroup]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Тариф'; })()

checks.title: required with nothing chosen keeps the form from sending (value-missing); the multiple field sends one entry per value

steps.check: (() => { const f = document.getElementById('f'); const d = new FormData(f); return f.checkValidity() === false && document.getElementById('c1').validity.valueMissing === true && d.get('kind') === null && JSON.stringify(d.getAll('targets')) === '["local"]'; })()

checks.title: the arrow keys move through the radios and choose: input then change once each, detail {value, item, checked}; the form sends the value

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('c1'); window.__said = []; el.addEventListener('input', (e) => window.__said.push('input:' + e.detail.value)); el.addEventListener('change', (e) => window.__said.push('change:' + e.detail.value + ':' + e.detail.item.value + ':' + e.detail.checked)); el.querySelectorAll('input')[0].focus(); el.querySelectorAll('input')[0].click(); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('c1'); return el.value === 'shop' && JSON.stringify(window.__said) === '["input:site","change:site:site:true","input:shop","change:shop:shop:true"]' && document.activeElement === el.querySelectorAll('input')[1] && new FormData(document.getElementById('f')).get('kind') === 'shop' && document.getElementById('f').checkValidity(); })()

checks.title: multiple: Space toggles a checkbox; the value keeps the options' order; a disabled option is not focusable

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('c2'); el.querySelectorAll('input')[1].focus(); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('c2'); return el.value === 'local,s3' && JSON.stringify(el.selected) === '["local","s3"]' && el.querySelectorAll('input')[2].disabled && JSON.stringify(new FormData(document.getElementById('f')).getAll('targets')) === '["local","s3"]'; })()

checks.title: a value set from code says nothing; a form reset returns to the value attribute without events

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('c2'); window.__quiet = 0; el.addEventListener('change', () => window.__quiet++); el.value = ['ftp', 's3', 'local']; return true; })()
